bounded_hypothesis.description: A fresh zero-network-capability AppContainer SID with parent/different-executable-path child token observations and independently positive transport controls may test a token-based containment alternative. This is a design, not a typed-status admission adapter or implemented launcher.
bounded_hypothesis.unknown_policy: Unknown launch, token identity, positive connectivity, cleanup or endpoint coverage never counts as denial. Limited transport controls cannot alone establish all-network/future-profile equivalence.

concrete_implementation_boundary.firewall_precondition: run requires verified_active_outbound_block and verified_active_inbound_block before CreateProcessW; substituting synthetic true flags for AppContainer evidence would misrepresent the existing refused guard.
concrete_implementation_boundary.launch_coupling: The runner constructs ordinary STARTUPINFO and ordinary CreateProcessW flags. It exposes no STARTUPINFOEX/SECURITY_CAPABILITIES or explicit inherited-handle-list launch hook.
concrete_implementation_boundary.additional_coupled_work: A truthful canary also needs a parent/child token-and-socket worker, fresh profile ownership, narrowly scoped scratch ACL grants/restoration, and profile/process/handle cleanup even when its outer watchdog interrupts. This exceeds straight reuse of the current small runner.
concrete_implementation_boundary.decision: Stopped before source writes under the assigned no-major-new-runner boundary. Do not expand Windows or dispatch a canary from this assessment.
concrete_implementation_boundary.not_claimed: This is an implementation/scope boundary, not a finding that intrinsic Windows APIs, hosted infrastructure or AppContainer are unavailable.
